verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt with agent-directed guidance. The Terminal docs are also served as raw markdown (terminal.md returns HTTP 200), and Stripe documents agent-first developer tools, so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable Terminal docs. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents using these docs, and confirmation that llms.txt explicitly indexes the Terminal pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
